claims.text: If no bacteria or yeast are detected, drying measures and agents are often therapeutic.
claims.quote: If no bacteria or yeast are detected, drying measures and agents are often therapeutic.

claims.text: Options: OTC antiperspirants w 20% aluminum chloride, and Burow solution compresses.
claims.quote: Effective options include over-the-counter antiperspirants containing 20% aluminum chloride and Burow solution compresses.

claims.text: Bacteria or yeast present: topical antibacterial lotions or antifungal creams in addition to drying agents.
claims.quote: If bacteria or yeast are present, topical antibacterial lotions or antifungal creams are given in addition to drying agents

claims.text: Intertriginous candidiasis: drying agents as needed (eg, Burow solution compresses for 15 to 20 minutes on exudative lesions) + topical antifungals.
claims.quote: Intertriginous infection is treated with drying agents as needed (eg, Burow solution compresses applied for 15 to 20 minutes for exudative lesions) and topical antifungals
